Given valid search text, when searching participations, then the matching participant should be returned
Given a participant id from search, when fetching the profile, then the profile id should match the participant id
Given a fetched profile, when checking core identity fields, then they should match the target user
Given a fetched profile, when checking program/enrollment fields, then they should reflect the correct enrollment data
Given the profile was persisted to a JSON file, when reloading it, then the stored data should exactly match the fetched profile
Given the profile JSON file was written, when checking the filesystem, then the file should exist on disk
Given a valid participant search, when searched by email, then the correct participant should be returned
Given a communication request payload, when sent, then the response should reflect the expected channel/subject/message
Given a communication was created, when the participant's communication list is fetched, then it should contain the created communication
Given the user logs into portal B, when notifications are fetched, then the sent push notification should be present and unread
Given an unread notification, when marked as read, then the API should confirm success
Given a notification was marked read, when notifications are re-fetched, then it should show as read
Given a notification was marked read, when the unread count is checked, then it should have decreased
